narrative: Needs work. The draft has several unsupported claims that need addressing. The statement about the relationship enabling deep insight during the diligence phase lacks any source backing. Either find a source that supports this or remove it. Similarly, the recommendation for approval of the commitment is unsupported; it needs a source or should be omitted. On the partially confirmed statements, the timing of Partners Group's commitment and the size of the equity checks are not fully verified. The source does not confirm the June 2026 date or the EUR 80-100 million equity checks. Verify these details or adjust the text to reflect only what is confirmed. Lastly, while Meridian Capital's strong track record and team are confirmed, the draft overreaches by attributing Partners Group's attraction to these factors without explicit source support. Adjust this to align with the evidence or provide a supporting source. Editorial and compliance are clean, so focus on these evidence issues.
